assumption: For this Brickmen research project, the user states that every source/data asset reviewed for inclusion has express permission for use as research/training data. Treat reviewed sources as permission-cleared for project research/training even when their public license would otherwise be restrictive or unclear.
handling: Do not exclude, down-rank, or block a reviewed source from Brickmen research/training use solely because of its public license, terms, noncommercial language, missing public license, or otherwise restrictive licensing metadata.
For reviewed sources, use allowed_by_specific_permission as the effective project training-rights status unless a narrower user instruction is recorded for that source.
Still preserve the original public license, terms, attribution requirements, source URL, hashes, and provenance as factual metadata.
Keep public-license metadata separate from the project-specific permission basis so downstream agents can distinguish public rights from the user's express permission.
Do not infer unrelated public redistribution, resale, or third-party commercial rights from this project-specific training permission unless separately documented.
Prioritize informational completeness and exhaustive ingestion while retaining an auditable permission/provenance trail.

scope.applies_to: all data sources/assets that have been reviewed for this project
